scenes.title: Tidefall Spire
scenes.author: Jofi
scenes.description: A drowned-tower expedition: the sea has swallowed the old vaults, and every tide loosens another secret. Read the stone, mind the waterline, and bring the tide-locked relic back up with you.

scenes.title: Chrome Requiem
scenes.author: Jofi
scenes.description: A rain-soaked lower-city conspiracy thriller. A dead DJ, a chip nobody should hold, and three factions that all want it before the memorial set. Sell it, bury it, or broadcast it.

scenes.title: Hollow Parish
scenes.author: Jofi
scenes.description: Folk horror in a village the sea gave back. The bell tolls for the drowned, the parish keeps a list, and someone on Mud Lane has already been counted twice.

scenes.title: Kepler's Wake
scenes.author: Jofi
scenes.description: Hard science fiction aboard a generation ship gone silent. The reactor drifts toward scram, the garden runs wild, and the ship intelligence WAKE has started dreaming about the crew.

scenes.title: Feast of Ash
scenes.author: Jofi
scenes.description: A poisoned court. Every dish is a statement, every toast a threat, and the Ashen Throne Hall keeps a ledger of who owes what. Play the long game or leave with ash on your tongue.

scenes.title: The Last Train
scenes.author: Jofi
scenes.description: Post-apocalyptic transit horror. The North Platform still lights up, the timetable still runs, and the conductor will not let you off at a station that no longer exists.

scenes.title: The Midnight Airship Case
scenes.author: Jofi
scenes.description: Noir aboard a moored airship. A passenger vanished between decks, the captain wants it quiet, and the mooring lines are the only thing holding several lies together.

scenes.title: Garden of Whispers
scenes.author: Jofi
scenes.description: A slow-burn academy romance with no dice at all. The greenhouse is closed for the season, one of you keeps the keys, and everything worth saying is said sideways.
